name: How should I choose a real estate agent for a 1031 exchange?

mainEntity.name: How should I choose a real estate agent for a 1031 exchange?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a real estate agent for a 1031 exchange, look for someone with experience in investment properties and a solid understanding of the exchange process and timelines. An agent familiar with the specific markets you are targeting, such as Miami-Dade or Palm Beach County, can be invaluable in quickly finding suitable replacement properties and coordinating with your Qualified Intermediary and other professionals. Verifying their experience with previous 1031 transactions is a key decision factor to ensure smooth execution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a real estate agent with experience in investment properties and 1031 exchanges, and strong local market knowledge, especially within your target areas.
